summary.intent: Get a front-end/design-ideation plan for the wisp-plugins repo reviewed as a formatted artifact, then start implementing Wave 0 conformance and enforcement fixes (WP-617, 620, 622, 624, 625) on the local evaluation branch without pushing.
summary.outcome: Created a private Docs artifact of the proposal. Implemented WP-617 (Codex model ids, bundle regenerated, committed), WP-620 (generated .claude-plugin manifests, validate recipe), WP-625 (reasoning-wording lint), and WP-624 as a spike (handback validator tested against 45 real verdicts). WP-622 is only partly done (root $schema removed). Only the Codex commit was made in this segment; the other changes were still uncommitted and nothing was pushed.

repo: Plugin manifests sat at plugin root, so `claude plugin validate plugins/<id>` false-passed; tools/sync-claude-manifests.py now generates plugins/<id>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and `just claude-validate` checks all 10 plugins under --strict.
Codex bundle in dist/codex is generated; after editing harnesses/codex/agent-roles/README.md run `just marketplace-sync` then `just marketplace-check` per the release policy.
Cross-harness source changes need a change record per shared/harness-authoring.md; this was written to docs/evaluations/frontend-design/IMPLEMENTATION-LOG.md.
Gate verdict schemas use allOf with if/then and list-valued types such as ["string","null"]; a validator must support both.
muse documents verdict@1 but 35 of 45 recorded verdicts are verdict@3-shaped, so the hook validator accepts either until muse migrates (WP-02).
All 12 recorded verdict violations were the same rule: verdict_summary over 300 characters (12 of 45, max 745).
Codex role-card model ids now are gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6-astra, checked against the Codex models page on 2026-10-20.
workflow: Run tests against real persisted data, not just synthetic fixtures: real verdicts exposed a list-of-types bug the unit tests missed.
Verify a lint by planting a violating file, confirming the test fails, then removing it.
The command guard rejects compound shell scripts and shell variables; use the file tools or single-purpose commands instead.
Commit by topic and use /usr/bin/git explicitly; keep a reproducing script for each measured finding.

friction: Docs connector `update` calls repeatedly failed on the placement of the `as` key beside `from` (three times), plus one malformed call, each needing a resend.
The command guard rejected a compound Python heredoc edit, forcing a switch to Read/Edit tools.
The earlier push was denied, so all work stays local on the branch.
Some Bash invocations needed rewriting (e.g. quoting --include globs, avoiding shell loops and variables).
open_items: Commit the remaining Wave 0 work (manifest generator, justfile and CI changes, lint test, handback validator and tests, docs and catalog updates); only the Codex fix is committed so far.
Push the branch and open a draft PR once the user gives explicit approval.
Finish WP-622: verify whether agy-plugins-cli discovers only top-level plugin directories, which would miss plugins under plugins/, and test in an isolated environment before changing the README.
Test a live SubagentStop/handback hook in auto mode and enable it first for smith, scribe, sentinel and ranger gates; onFailure:"block" needs CLI 2.1.295 and the current CLI is 2.1.292.
Migrate muse from verdict@1 to verdict@3 (WP-02).
Re-run the refusal probe on Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Haiku 5.5; check install behavior of the `shared` symlink per harness.
Check whether skills-ref rejects a top-level `version` and whether Codex loads Claude agents or hooks.
Add the user's note that the early Storybook experiment used Opus 4.5 and the matching Sonnet, after confirming those version names.
No version or changelog bumps were made; releases remain to be handled per policy.
